items.title: Hubert Laws — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...the arranger is Bill Fischer. >> [INTERVIEWEE] That’s it, Bill Fischer.

ctx.x: So he had that too. He had that gospel. I think that’s one of those dimensions of greatness, is being able to embrace it all. I’m looking at – I found the aforementioned Bill: the arranger is Bill Fischer.
Because he was – because when we look at McCoy Tyner, La Leyenda de la Hora, the legend of the hour. He’s the arranger on that. So he was the one that did Fly With the Wind as well.
